title: Compliance sprint cheatsheet — Tomas
body:
Morning micro-sprint (Tomas) — quick brain dump and actionable items

Top-of-mind goals for today:
- Finalize vendor access matrix for 3rd-party logging vendors (priority: high)
- Close missing attachments for SOC2 Control CC6 evidence packet
- Draft note for policy exceptions review (weekly sync)

Quick TODOs (1–2 hour tasks)
- [ ] Pull export of vendor IAM roles from cloud console (INF-4123) — tag: maya for verification
- [ ] Upload screenshots for login session retention (CC6) to Confluence page — include timestamps + obfuscated user ids
- [ ] Send short vendor questionnaire to SentryOps and LogStream (questions inline below)
- [ ] Create one-pager for exceptions request flow (owner: Tomas)

Evidence triage notes
- CC6 (Access controls): missing artifact list: MFA proof for service accounts, role change approval email for infra-groups, time-bound access exceptions log.
- Encryption at rest (CC3): need key rotation policy snapshot. I have KMS rotation policy but missing HSM attestation — reach out to Priya.
- Incident response (CC7): attach the last 6-month tabletop notes. Check SRE drive folder for slides: might be under shared_drives/company/misc (if not, ping Diego).

Vendor review quick checklist (for email to vendor)
- Company legal name + org chart (confirm parent/subs)
- SOC2 or ISO attestations (latest date) + auditor name
- Data residency: which regions do you store logs/backups?
- Access model: do vendor engineers have interactive console? How are service accounts scoped?
- Retention: default retention windows and deletion request SLA
- Incident notification SLA and security contact (email + phone)

Draft vendor questionnaire snippet (to paste into email)
"Hi — quick follow up from our security intake. Please provide: 1) copy of your most recent SOC2 or ISO report (or letter of attestation), 2) short description of your access control model for customer data, 3) confirmation of region(s) where backups and logs are stored, 4) your incident notification contact and SLA. Thanks — Tomas (Redwood Inference)"

Policy TODOs & timeline
- Exceptions request doc: draft by 2026-03-15, review with Gabi (legal) by 2026-03-17
- Evidence collection sprint: bulk uploads due 2026-03-20
- Policy cleanup: deprecate old data retention table and replace with simplified map (owner: Priya) by 2026-03-25

Notes-to-self (loose ideas)
- Could we add a tiny client-side token rotation checklist in the onboarding README? Might reduce SOC2 friction during audits.
- Consider a simple GitHub Actions job that zips the Confluence page attachments and pushes to a protected S3 bucket for snapshotting. Ask infra team about IAM role.

Open questions / blockers
- Do we have a signed BAA with LogStream? I think we started one but not finalized. If no BAA, escalate to legal. (Action: Maya to chase legal).
- KMS attestation: who owns HSM reports? Priya maybe. Need contact.

Slack reminders (to send later)
- @here quick ping in #security-compliance: "Uploading CC6 artifacts today — will need 1 reviewer to sign off after upload"
- DM Diego for incident tabletop slide location

Mini playbook (step-by-step for a quick evidence handoff)
1) Identify control + artifact name (e.g., CC6 - MFA proof for SAs)
2) Grab raw export (screenshot, csv) and add short context comment (who, when, why)
3) Upload to Confluence attachments with filename pattern: controlname_owner_YYYYMMDD
4) Create a ticket INF-XXXX link in Confluence comment for traceability
5) Notify reviewer (Maya/Priya) via Slack with link and short checklist

End note: keep today's focus narrow — ship the Confluence uploads and the vendor questionnaire. Anything else can be triaged into next sprint.

-- Tomas R

References to follow up:
- Confluence: /pages/viewpage.action?pageId=12345678 (internal evidence index)
- Jira: INF-4123 (vendor IAM export)
- PR: github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/789 (automation for snapshot)
